The medical student I spoke to originally was phenomenal, and Dr. Narra could really do with learning from her. She then told me that gastro or gyno “want nothing to do with me” and that “no one wants to see me.”

All quotations are her exact words.

I don’t care what qualifications she has, the woman has no people skills, empathy, or basic politeness. For someone who suffers with low mood and low self-esteem, being told that you’re too much and come with too much baggage was actually dangerous.
